title: Prove a Clean Checkout Has No Hidden Local Help
teaser: A release path should not depend on files left behind on one workstation.
full_text: Run the required production steps from a clean checkout using only repository content and reject any hidden local dependency.

title: Prevent Duplicate Identity During Restore
teaser: Restoring the same archive twice must not silently multiply the same logical record.
full_text: Import one backup twice and verify the collision policy produces a deterministic result.

title: Force the PDF Font Through Real Unicode Text
teaser: ASCII-only checks can hide broken multilingual font embedding.
full_text: Generate a report containing Turkish characters and composed Unicode examples and verify the parser can read the text back.

title: Handle Polar Solar Events Explicitly
teaser: Not every coordinate has a daily sunrise and sunset.
full_text: Use polar-day and polar-night fixtures and verify the engine returns an explicit no-event result rather than invented times.

title: Block Free Export at the Domain Boundary
teaser: Hiding a button does not stop protected data from being generated.
full_text: Invoke the export service directly under Free entitlement and verify PRO-only output is never produced.

title: Stabilize Snapshot Hashes for Identical Inputs
teaser: The same immutable input should not create arbitrary artifact differences.
full_text: Calculate one unchanged profile twice and verify the canonical snapshot hashes match exactly.

title: Keep Keyboard Focus Inside an Open Modal
teaser: Focus must not escape into controls behind an active dialog.
full_text: Navigate forward and backward by keyboard and verify the focus trap remains inside the modal boundary.

title: Reject Unexpected Files Inside a Backup Archive
teaser: A restore package should contain only approved manifest and data entries.
full_text: Insert an unknown file into a backup and verify validation rejects the package before restore begins.

title: Normalize Moon Phase Angles at the Wrap Boundary
teaser: Zero degrees and 360 degrees represent the same phase boundary.
full_text: Run fixtures around 359.999 and 0.001 degrees and verify classification remains continuous.

title: Separate Locale Date Formatting From Stored Identity
teaser: Display rules can change without mutating the persisted date key.
full_text: Render one record in TR and EN and verify its canonical ISO date remains unchanged.

title: Delete Cached Reports When a Profile Is Deleted
teaser: Removed user data should not survive in an old report cache.
full_text: Generate a report for one profile delete that profile and verify related cached artifacts are removed.

title: Never Reuse a Backup Encryption Nonce
teaser: Nonce reuse under one key weakens archive confidentiality.
full_text: Create two encrypted backups in sequence and verify their nonce values are different.

title: Close Planetary Hour Segments Across the Full Day
teaser: Day and night segments must not leave gaps or overlaps.
full_text: Generate all 24 segment boundaries and verify each end instant equals the next segment start.

title: Refresh UI Reference Hashes After Visual Changes
teaser: A changed golden asset cannot keep an old approval digest.
full_text: Modify one reference asset and verify the visual gate fails until provenance and approval hash are updated.

title: Canonicalize CSV Line Endings Across Platforms
teaser: Platform-specific newlines should not break deterministic byte comparison.
full_text: Normalize export output to the canonical newline contract and verify identical fixtures produce identical bytes.

title: Resolve Coordinates Again When Birthplace Changes
teaser: A new city label paired with old coordinates creates silent calculation drift.
full_text: Change the birthplace and verify persisted location identity and coordinates update together.

title: Reevaluate Ad Paths After PRO Restore
teaser: Restored entitlement must not keep a stale Free advertising path alive.
full_text: Complete purchase restore then resume lifecycle and verify ad loading is suppressed by the new entitlement.

title: Paginate Long PDF Text Without Orphaned Headings
teaser: A heading or single line should not be stranded at a page edge.
full_text: Generate a long section and verify heading widow and orphan rules survive pagination.

title: Carry Astrology Degrees Across the Thirty Degree Boundary
teaser: Thirty degrees of one sign is zero degrees of the next sign.
full_text: Test 29.999999 and 30.000001 degree fixtures and verify sign index and displayed degree are correct.

title: Relabel Open Search Results After Locale Change
teaser: Changing language should not leave stale locale text on screen.
full_text: Keep city search open switch locale and verify visible country and region labels refresh immediately.

title: Derive Backup Table Count From the Schema Registry
teaser: A handwritten table count becomes stale when the schema evolves.
full_text: Generate the expected table set from the backup registry and compare it exactly with the archive manifest.

title: Scan the Release Artifact for Test Credentials
teaser: Unused development credentials still should not ship inside production packages.
full_text: Scan release files for known test keys and placeholder secret patterns and require zero matches.

title: Preserve Form State Through Rotation
teaser: Orientation changes should not erase unsaved user input.
full_text: Partially complete a long form rotate the device and verify field values and validation state remain intact.

title: Test Numerology Name Normalization Explicitly
teaser: Unicode normalization differences can silently alter letter values.
full_text: Use accented and composed-name fixtures and compare normalized letters and numeric output with golden values.

title: Remove Partial Backup Files After User Cancellation
teaser: Cancelling a share flow must not leave a staging archive in persistent storage.
full_text: Cancel export during file selection and verify temporary backup artifacts are deleted.

title: Keep Semantic Heading Levels in Order
teaser: Assistive users rely on heading structure rather than visual size alone.
full_text: Inspect a report and settings screen and verify heading levels are sequential and meaningful.

title: Recompute Daily Snapshot Identity at the Correct Day Boundary
teaser: Mixing local-day and astronomical boundaries can attach daily data to the wrong date.
full_text: Use a timezone-edge fixture and verify the snapshot key follows the contracted local date.

title: Distinguish Local Validation Errors While Offline
teaser: No network should not turn every failure into a connectivity message.
full_text: Trigger a local validation error in airplane mode and verify the user-facing message preserves the real error class.

title: Compare Monthly Shard Row Keys With the Calendar
teaser: A correct total can still hide one missing and one duplicated day.
full_text: Generate all 30 November 2034 dates and compare them exactly with the TR shard key set.

title: Close November With an Exact Continuation Date
teaser: Progress state should name the exact first day of the next batch.
full_text: Reconcile committed TR and EN shards and write 2034-12-01 as the next checkpoint boundary.
